newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore government securities end narrowly mixed.
newsitem.headline: Singapore government securities end narrowly mixed.

text.p: Singapore government securities ended narrowly mixed on Tuesday in moderate trade on retail and interbank interest, dealers said.

"Government securities were narrowly mixed today amid continued uncertainty over the near-term direction of the market. Treasury bill yields were slightly higher but bond prices were slightly lower. Volume was moderate," a local dealer said.
In treasury bills, three-months closed at a yield of 2.10/2.05 percent compared with Monday's yield of 1.87/1.82 percent.
